title: Subspace Tripmine
body:
"A hidden deathtrap, waiting to be USED! Powered by purple goop >:D"

Description

The Subspace Tripmine is a special item bought in the Classic Store for $1,010. It is part of the random rotation in the store.

When used, the Subspace Tripmine plants a mine in front of the user, which when stationary, will turn invisible.

If stepped on by anybody with permissions on your base (including the user), the tripmine instantly explodes, killing those close to it and converting certain objects and schematics nearby temporarily pink with sparkles.

Trivia

  • Only one mine can be placed by a person's tool at one time.
  • This item can be used to ruin a person's grind (and day) by placing it in risky locations like the plank bridges near the Magma Caves.
  • Master trolling item.
  • The Subspace Tripmine works and sounds incredibly similar to the original Roblox gear, the Subspace Tripmine, however it is modified slightly.[1]

Subspace Climbing

Subspace Climbing is a strategy that you can use to climb large walls. You begin by standing close to the wall. You then spam the mine while moving forward and jumping. Using an autoclicker can help with this process. If you use the strategy on a corner, it can make the process way easier.
